recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓被多形性大細胞取代，細胞核深染、形狀不規則且部分呈梭形，排列於纖維化基質中呈肉瘤樣外觀，並可見核分裂與少數嗜酸性球；此類 ALCL 侵犯容易被誤認為肉瘤或轉移癌。
features: Marrow space adjacent to a bony trabecula (lower left) replaced by a pleomorphic infiltrate
Large atypical cells with irregular, hyperchromatic, some spindled or elongated nuclei
Moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm; occasional cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli
Background fibrosis with streaming, sarcomatoid-like arrangement
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional eosinophils; normal hematopoiesis absent in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows the intertrabecular space replaced by a pleomorphic infiltrate of large atypical cells with irregular, hyperchromatic, partly spindled nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, set in a fibrotic stroma with a streaming, sarcomatoid pattern. Mitotic figures and scattered eosinophils are present, and normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field. Hallmark cells are not unequivocally identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma with associated fibrosis, but immunohistochemistry (CD30, ALK, CD45, keratin) is essential to exclude sarcoma or metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: It shows cytokeratin positivity and is negative for CD30, ALK and CD45.

ddx.dx: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma or other sarcoma
ddx.vs: Sarcomas express mesenchymal markers and lack CD30, ALK, CD45 and T-cell antigens.
Hodgkin cells are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background and are CD15+ and ALK negative.
Myelofibrosis contains clustered atypical megakaryocytes and residual hematopoiesis rather than sheets of atypical CD30-positive cells.
